## Overview

The 14th AIAA Thermophysics and Heat Transfer Conference continues a 56-year tradition covering thermophysics and heat transfer in aerospace: thermal protection systems, ablation, aerothermal environments, surface radiation. Emissivity of high-temperature aerospace materials is directly relevant.
